name: What information do I need to prepare before meeting a contractor for a new room addition?
description: Before meeting a contractor, prepare existing property plans, define your goals, desired features, budget range, and inspiration photos.

mainEntity.name: What information do I need to prepare before meeting a contractor for a new room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before meeting a contractor for a new room addition, gather any existing property surveys, architectural plans, or floor plans you have. It's also helpful to define your goals for the new space, including its intended use, approximate size, and any specific features or finishes you envision. Creating a budget range and collecting inspiration photos can help communicate your vision clearly, allowing us to provide more accurate initial assessments and recommendations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before meeting a contractor, prepare existing property plans, define your goals, desired features, budget range, and inspiration photos.
